name: LA Plaza Village
description: LA Plaza Village is a vibrant cultural and retail destination in downtown Los Angeles that celebrates Mexican and Mexican-American heritage through its unique blend of shops, dining, and cultural programming. Located in the historic El Pueblo de Los Angeles area near Olvera Street, this open-air center serves as a gathering place for the community while showcasing authentic artisan goods, traditional cuisine, and cultural experiences that honor the region's rich Latino roots.
summary: A culturally-focused open-air destination in downtown Los Angeles celebrating Mexican-American heritage through authentic retail, dining, and community experiences.
